toolboxes.name: Utilities

toolboxes.lead: Utilities that run entirely in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

tools.name: Alarm
tools.description: Set an alarm

tools.name: Timer
tools.description: Count down a set time

tools.name: Stopwatch
tools.description: Measure elapsed time

tools.name: Date Countdown
tools.description: Count down to a date

tools.name: World Time
tools.description: See the time around the world

tools.name: Break Time
tools.description: Get reminded to take breaks

tools.name: Recognize Text
tools.description: Extract text from images (OCR)

tools.name: Transform Text
tools.description: Change case, clean up and reformat text

tools.name: Barcode Generator
tools.description: Create QR codes and barcodes

tools.name: Barcode Reader
tools.description: Scan QR codes and barcodes

tools.name: Unit Converter

tools.name: Find Duplicates

tools.name: Resize Images

tools.name: Make GIF
tools.description: Turn a video or images into a GIF

tools.name: Convert Media
tools.description: Convert audio and video between formats, or extract the audio

toolboxes.name: Developer
toolboxes.summary: Developer utilities: JSON, encoding, tokens, regex, diffs, bits and bytes.

tools.name: Bit

tools.name: Timestamp Converter

tools.name: Text Diff
tools.description: Compare two texts line by line

tools.name: JSON Formatter

tools.name: JSON Diff
tools.description: Compare two JSON documents

tools.name: YAML ↔ JSON
tools.description: Convert between YAML and JSON

tools.name: CSV ↔ JSON
tools.description: Convert between CSV and JSON

tools.name: SQL Formatter
tools.description: Format and beautify SQL queries

tools.name: User-Agent Parser
tools.description: Identify browser, OS and device from a User-Agent

toolboxes.name: Cryptography
toolboxes.summary: Hashes, HMAC, key derivation, encryption, keys, signatures, certificates and secrets.
toolboxes.lead: Cryptography tools that run entirely in your browser. Keys and secrets you enter never leave your device.

tools.name: Hash
tools.description: Hash text, hex or files with MD5, SHA-1/2/3, Keccak, BLAKE2/3 and RIPEMD-160
tools.keywords: sha256 sha512 sha3 keccak blake2 blake3 ripemd160 md5 sha1 checksum

tools.name: HMAC
tools.description: Compute an HMAC with any hash

tools.name: Password Hash
tools.description: Hash and verify passwords with bcrypt, scrypt and Argon2

tools.name: Key Derivation
tools.description: Derive keys with PBKDF2 and HKDF

tools.name: Encryption
tools.description: Encrypt and decrypt with AES (GCM, CBC, CTR) and ChaCha20-Poly1305
tools.keywords: aes gcm cbc ctr chacha20 poly1305 cipher

tools.name: Key Generator
tools.description: Generate Ed25519, X25519, P-256/384, secp256k1 and RSA keys
tools.keywords: keypair rsa ecdsa ed25519 pem jwk

tools.name: Key Converter
tools.description: Convert keys between PEM, DER, JWK and raw bytes

tools.name: ECDH
tools.description: Compute a shared secret with X25519, P-256 or secp256k1

tools.name: Sign & Verify
tools.description: Sign and verify with ECDSA, EdDSA, Schnorr (BIP340) and RSA-PSS
tools.keywords: ecdsa eddsa ed25519 schnorr bip340 rsa signature secp256k1

tools.name: DER Signature
tools.description: Convert a signature between raw (r, s) and DER

tools.name: X.509 / CSR Decoder
tools.description: Decode a certificate or signing request
tools.keywords: certificate csr pem tls ssl fingerprint

tools.name: ASN.1 Decoder
tools.description: Decode ASN.1 DER or PEM into a tree

tools.name: Random Generator
tools.description: Generate random bytes, passwords and passphrases

tools.name: Secret Sharing
tools.description: Split a secret into shares and recover it (Shamir)

tools.name: TOTP / HOTP
tools.description: Generate one-time codes from a secret

tools.name: Modular Arithmetic
tools.description: Modular inverse, power and GCD with big integers
tools.keywords: mod inverse pow gcd bigint secp256k1

toolboxes.name: Bitcoin
toolboxes.summary: Bitcoin: blocks, transactions, PSBTs, keys, addresses and HD wallets.
toolboxes.lead: Bitcoin tools that run entirely in your browser. Keys you enter never leave your device.

tools.description: Decode a block header and compute its hash
tools.keywords: block hash proof of work pow

tools.name: Merkle Root
tools.description: Compute the merkle root of a list of TXIDs

tools.name: Target Bits
